task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to grab the beige paymentsign with printed details and rotate QR code towards you.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架后使用左臂抓住印有细节的米色支付标志并向您旋转二维码。
